_about: Screens photographed side by side each day. ios_args: launch arguments for the DEBUG iPhone app. android_start: the `adb shell` command that opens the same screen (the DEBUG Android build reads --es mwTab). wait: seconds to settle. IMPORTANT: -mwTab runs in the iPhone's credential-free debug host, so these show chrome + empty states (headers, bar, spine, cards, typography), not live data. Data screens need both apps signed in to the same local test tenant (scripts/local-android.sh) — add those entries once that is wired.
